defects.cause: The formatter module is removed/renamed while report.py still imports its old module name.
defects.trigger: The email adapter imports report after deploying the complete head source tree.
defects.consequence: ModuleNotFoundError prevents report loading, so all invoice report rendering becomes unavailable.
defects.boundary: formatter.py -> rendering.py rename and report.py import dependency

evidence.report_change: The report module adds a module docstring but retains the formatter import in the changed file.

defects.proof: The oracle uses an isolated in-memory importer that resolves only fixture modules, avoiding accidental host formatter imports. Head fails import; base/control render identical output.

control.report.py:
"""Billing report adapter for customer-facing invoice messages."""

from rendering import format_customer, format_total


def render_invoice(invoice):
    """Render the plain-text billing summary used by the email adapter."""
    if not isinstance(invoice, dict):
        raise ValueError("invoice must be an object")
    customer = format_customer(invoice["customer"])
    total = format_total(invoice["total_cents"])
    invoice_id = invoice["id"]
    return f"Invoice {invoice_id}\nCustomer: {customer}\nTotal: {total}\n"


def email_subject(invoice):
    return f"Invoice {invoice['id']} for {format_customer(invoice['customer'])}"


def render_batch(invoices):
    return [render_invoice(invoice) for invoice in invoices]
